cases.title_zh: 反例：循环携带依赖前缀和

public_input.code: void Prefix(float *out, const float *in, size_t count) { float carry = 0.0F; for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) { carry += in[i]; out[i] = carry; } }

int ReadFile(int fd, uint8_t *buffer, size_t count) { size_t done = 0; while (done < count) { const int n = read(fd, buffer + done, count - done); if (n <= 0) return -1; done += static_cast<size_t>(n); } return 0; }
